title: BSE market cap crosses Rs 500 lakh crore driven by IPOs, steady recovery
summary: The BSE has hit a significant milestone as the collective market capitalization of listed firms exceeded ₹500 lakh crore, driven by a comprehensive market rally and new listings. Although many indices remain below their historical peaks, strong demand from foreign portfolio investors and favorable global signals have led to an uplift in market sentiment. Challenges such as geopolitical shifts and profit booking, however, could threaten future expansion.

title: Demat account additions hit 9-month high in October as IPO boom draws investors
summary: In October 2026, new demat account additions reached a nine-month high, driven by strong IPO activity. NSDL and CDSL reported adding nearly 3.36 million accounts during the month. The total number of demat accounts at the end of October was approximately 244 million. The increase in account openings was mainly influenced by the successful launch of several public issues.

title: Stock Radar: Coforge stock hits fresh record high in November 2026; will the rally continue?
summary: Coforge Ltd has successfully broken out of a lengthy consolidation phase that lasted over two months. The stock now shows potential targets above the 2,200 levels in the upcoming weeks. Key support levels are established, with immediate support at 1,940 and previous resistance around 2,000. Experts suggest maintaining strategic stop losses to manage potential downside risks effectively. Momentum indicators favor continued bullish trends, indicating further growth opportunities for traders.
